name: smoke-ring
summary: Full-bleed hero running Paper Shaders' smoke ring on WebGL2: a turning ring of white smoke around a clear centre on black, the copy sitting in the hole rather than fighting the smoke.

colors.description: The smoke colour. Upstream ships exactly one; adding more bands the ring through a gradient. Omit to read --fx-c1 off the section, which is what keeps the shader and the CSS resting state on one colour. Upstream default preset.

speed.description: Rate the smoke turns over. 0 renders a single static frame. Forced to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion.

radius.description: Radius of the clear centre the ring is drawn around. This is the hole the headline sits in.

thickness.description: How far the smoke reaches outward from that radius.

noiseScale.description: Size of the turbulence in the smoke. Higher is finer, wispier detail.

deviations.what: The noise texture is decoded before ShaderMount is constructed, so the shader starts one microtask later than a React mount would.
deviations.why: Seam. Upstream's React component hands getShaderNoiseTexture() straight to ShaderMount and re-renders when it loads; a vanilla mount has no re-render, and ShaderMount throws on an image that is not complete. The image is a data: URI, so nothing is fetched.
